description: SGMA Climate Change Resources is a dataset listed in State of California open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by California Department of Water Resources. This dataset includes processed climate change datasets related to climatology, hydrology, and water operations. The climatological data provided are change factors for precipitation and reference evapotranspiration gridded over the entire State. Coverage: California. The portal files it under the publisher California Department of Water Resources. Its tags are CWC, DWR, SGMA, WSIP, california department of water resources. The licence is other licence as labelled on the portal (terms not stated).
